verdict.rationale: dlt has an official CLI with a first-party reference page; it creates, adds, inspects and deploys pipelines (dlt-docs-10, dlt-probe-5). The dltHub CLI adds single-command deploy (`dlthub deploy`) plus monitoring, logs and failure diagnosis (dlt-docs-11, dlt-docs-15). It also ties into agent workflows, launching a coding agent from a Playground workspace (dlt-docs-44). Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and no evidence of agent-oriented CLI features such as machine-readable/JSON output or non-interactive modes.
